import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    df = inputs["rate_feed"].copy()

    # Sort per cursor ORDER BY account_id, obs_date, obs_seq
    df = df.sort_values(
        by=["account_id", "obs_date", "obs_seq"],
        kind="mergesort"
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    # Forward-fill rate within each account group (carry never crosses accounts)
    filled = df.groupby("account_id", sort=False)["rate"].ffill()

    rate_filled = df["rate"].where(df["rate"].notna(), filled)
    was_carried = (df["rate"].isna() & filled.notna()).astype("int64")

    out = pd.DataFrame({
        "account_id": df["account_id"],
        "obs_seq": df["obs_seq"],
        "obs_date": df["obs_date"],
        "rate_filled": rate_filled,
        "was_carried": was_carried,
    })

    return {"rate_filled": out}
